title: Practice 5: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я ___ (навести / наводить — to introduce, bring, produce, make, cause) на вас тоску.
exercises.why: **наведу** is the future tense (1st person singular) of **навести** (to direct (at), to aim (at), to point (at); to cover, to coat, to apply) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **наводить**. future: я наведу́ · ты наведёшь · он наведёт · мы наведём · вы наведёте · они наведу́т. — Wiktionary, «навести» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**на-** — Movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion Example: Туча наползла на солнце. — A cloud crept onto the sun. Prepositional phrases: в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Иван Гончаров, «Обыкновенная история».
exercises.context: **на-** — Movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion Example: Туча наползла на солнце. — A cloud crept onto the sun. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0))

exercises.q: В окружной центр Корчагин ___ (наезжать / наехать — to come in large numbers) редко.
exercises.why: **наезжал** is the past tense (masculine) of **наезжать** (to run into, to hit [with на (na, + accusative) ‘someone/something’]; (colloquial, imperfective only) to visit periodically [with в (v, + accusative) ‘someone/something’]) — imperfective; its perfective partner is **наехать**. past: он наезжа́л · она наезжа́ла · оно наезжа́ло · они наезжа́ли. — Wiktionary, «наезжать» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**на-** — Movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion Example: Туча наползла на солнце. — A cloud crept onto the sun. Prepositional phrases: в/на + acc.; without preposition + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Николай Островский, «Как закалялась сталь».
exercises.context: **на-** — Movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion Example: Туча наползла на солнце. — A cloud crept onto the sun. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0))

exercises.q: ___ (налетать / налететь — to fly, to come flying) банда на тихие волостные местечки.
exercises.why: **налетала** is the past tense (feminine) of **налетать** (to fly (upon, against), to come flying (to); (colloquial) to bump (into), to run (into), to hit, to collide (with)) — imperfective; its perfective partner is **налететь**. past: он налета́л · она налета́ла · оно налета́ло · они налета́ли. — Wiktionary, «налетать» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**на-** — Movement onto the surface of an object; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion Example: Туча наползла на солнце. — A cloud crept onto the sun. exercises.q: ___ (взойти / всходить — to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend) на эшафот, капитан!
exercises.why: **взойдёмте** is the imperative (вы, plural or polite) of **взойти** (to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend; to rise (of a heavenly body)) — perfective; its imperfective partner is **всходить**. imperative: взойди́ · взойди́те. — Wiktionary, «взойти» (CC BY-SA 4.0).  «**вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-** — Movement upwards. Antonym: с- Example: Альпинист взошёл на гору. — The mountain climber walked up the mountain. Prepositional phrases: в / на + acc.» — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  From Александр Куприн, «Штабс-капитан Рыбников».
exercises.context: **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-** — Movement upwards. (Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» § Verbs of motion (CC BY-SA 4.0))
